title: potentilla gracilis var. flabelliformis
intro: Potentilla gracilis var. flabelliformis, commonly known as Dwarf Cinquefoil, is a plant species in the rose family (Rosaceae). It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from various health issues. The health benefits of this plant include its potential to help reduce inflammation, improve digestive health, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Dwarf Cinquefoil are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties.
